object.name: Iota Pegasi A
object.notes: Corrected CNS5 5470; exact source identity * iot Peg. Former system source snapshot, shared as an approximate component position and proper motion. No resolved orbital trajectory is claimed. Adopt component dynamical masses, without copying combined spectrum or photometry. Reviewed membership and individual physical parameters: arXiv:astro-ph/9811029. Individually reviewed physical values/withholding: arXiv:astro-ph/9811029; supersedes blended-source values for these fields. Withheld individual fields: metallicity_dex, absolute_mag. Estimated temperature from Pecaut-Mamajek 2022.04.16 F5V mean dwarf sequence (interpolation where needed); not an object-specific measurement. luminosity_solar derived by Stefan-Boltzmann scaling from adopted inputs (solar Teff=5772 K); inherits their measurement/model/estimate assumptions. Reviewed component supplement: Reviewed individual spectrum permits a mean-dwarf temperature estimate when no object-specific temperature is available. Adopted fields: spectral_type: 1999ApJ...515..356B:Table 4 (measured); radius_solar: 1999ApJ...515..356B:Table 4 (derived); age_gyr: 1999ApJ...515..356B:4 (model-derived); temperature_k: Pecaut-Mamajek 2022.04.16 (estimated); luminosity_solar: Stefan-Boltzmann scaling (derived). Reviewed companion expansion of western-constellation-stars: Iota Pegasi A; adopted nearest-1000:cns5-5470.
